_comment: Hand-maintained inputs of scripts/characterization_report.py. Verdicts are NOT here: they come from the 'Current reading' digest of spec/gap-to-submission.md. Evidence entries name an experiment (resolved to its live, non-superseded records) or one record_id (which must be live). Every number below is copied from the cited record's Claim. Since issue #524 (schema 2), each non-passing row carries an "owner": {"issues": [...]} naming the open issue(s) that would move its verdict and/or "waits": "..." naming the ratification it waits on; issue openness is verified against the live tracker when the owner is recorded, never fetched by the generator.

1.target: UART, SPI modes 0-3, I2C Standard+Fast as firmware
1.measured: Firmware passes the independent reference models at RTL and gate level; constrained-random suite passes (UART RX included)
1.conditions: RTL / zero-delay gate level, 50 MHz clock

3.measured: ABC PDR and rIC3 1.5.2 proved all 5 standalone serial-loader assertions and all 8 integrated core timing assertions unbounded. ABC PDR also proved the 5 integrated load/fetch assertions. The standalone proof checks every SRAM write through address 255 and saturation. The integrated model aliases SRAM to 8 words and releases reset once.
3.conditions: RTL, unbounded IC3/PDR and bounded Z3 checks

4.measured: Closes at 20 ns on 3 of the 6 declared corners (LibreLane); klt leg (netlist estimate, pre-CTS): setup closes, hold fails at the 3 macro corners; see the Fmax table

5.measured: Top instantiates the full pin budget; runtime uio direction rests on Proposed DR 0012

6.target: 256x16 program memory, serial or boot-ROM load
6.measured: Load, CRC integrity and boot paths pass on the SRAM-macro-backed memory; no silicon clock demonstrated

7.measured: See the area table: macro-backed design is 58.55 % of the 2x2 core on LibreLane; the klt P&R leg now measures die 161,592 um^2 (8.96 tiles, 2.24x the 2x2 budget) at 41.83 % placed utilization; budget row stays unmet per the tracker (DR 0005 unratified)

8.measured: SDF-annotated post-route regression passes at 3 corners; SRAM timing zero-delay and some gate-level images stale

9.measured: Licence set, template wired, gds workflow jobs green on the harness stub; final-design sign-off run still to come

10.measured: Cycles only, no baud measured; TX at 434 cycles/bit measured in cycles (0.000 % frame drift, firmware-uart-rx record)

11.measured: All four modes at the f_clk/4 ceiling as a cycle ratio; pad edge rates uncharacterized

12.target: I2C Standard and Fast-mode minimum timings
12.measured: Minimums met in cycles on a logical pad model; stale gate-level/SDF records for the Fast-mode images
12.conditions: RTL, cycle counts, zero-delay pad model

13.target: A protocol outside rows 1-2 as firmware
13.measured: WS2812 and PS/2 pass their models at RTL and gate level; row not ratified

14.measured: (a), (b), reselect pass zero-delay; release-offset sweep passes under SDF at 3 corners; pads not covered; row not ratified

klt_timing.status: macro-backed netlist-estimate result produced by the fleet klt 0.9.2 (klayout-tools release v0.9.2, git commit 046ba74652fc; PIN_KLAYOUT_TOOLS_VERSION in 2AMLogic/2am infra/aws/batch-image-pins.env, read 2026-11-20), run in a throwaway uvx environment over IHP-Open-PDK commit f7bca32694fe3d58be0cc7d9df4b9f5db7161a14 (stamped from the run host's .pdk-store.json): setup at 20 ns closes at the 3 macro-characterized corners (worst +2.867 ns), hold fails at all 3 (worst -0.2266 ns, 23 violating endpoints each; no placement, CTS or hold repair), so 50 MHz is not shown to close on the klt flow. Every figure is byte-identical to the superseded klt 0.8.1.dev146 record (issue #394 re-mint, per #377); the record's Flow comparison now quotes the live LibreLane fast-corner hold +0.0830 ns (20261011-144900-e5a0bae pair), not the superseded +0.1156 ns

area.item: Placed cells + SRAM macro, share of 2x2 core
Top-level synthesized cell area (2,526 instances, sequential 12,933.0432 um^2)

area.value: die 161,592 um^2 / core 156,242 um^2 at 41.83 % placed utilization (40 % requested) = 8.96 tiles = 2.24x the 2x2 budget; program memory alone: die 84,204.4 um^2 at 40.68 % (klt 0.9.2, IHP-Open-PDK f7bca326, SRAM macro fixed at (7,7) R0, stage place, no PDN)

power.reason: No dynamic-power estimate exists in either flow. `klt sta` can report power from a routed netlist, but no routed klt netlist exists (the klt leg stops at a netlist estimate); the LibreLane runs behind the committed GDS do not commit a power report. No power spec row exists, so no budget is graded.

findings: Row 7: the LibreLane flow places the macro-backed design inside the 2x2 core (58.55 %), yet the tracker keeps the row unmet because DR 0005 (SRAM macro) is unratified; the klt P&R leg's first placed measurement (die 161,592 um^2, 8.96 tiles at 41.83 % placed utilization, macro included, no PDN) exceeds the 2x2 budget at that utilization, and the report follows the tracker and does not pick either flow's number as the answer.

Row 4: LibreLane reports 3 of the 6 declared corners as closing with 0 setup/hold violations; the klt netlist estimate closes setup but fails hold at the same 3 corners (pre-CTS, no hold repair). The flows differ on hold; this is a finding to record, not a number to pick from.
